# Comprehensive 89㎡ Modern Home Soft Furnishing & Appliance Shopping Plan (¥100,000 RMB Budget)

Transitioning from hard furnishings to soft furnishings in an **89㎡ three-bedroom, one-living-room (3B1L)** apartment requires a strategic balance between aesthetics, functionality, spatial constraints, and budget management. A modern design featuring pure white walls and cool gray tiled/laminate flooring creates a clean, expansive visual foundation. However, without warm layers, high-touch textures, and thoughtful lighting, gray-and-white spaces can feel cold and clinical. Furthermore, designing for a household with a pet (an active cat) and long hours of sitting requires careful material selection (scratch-resistant, easy-to-clean fabrics) and ergonomic seating options with proper lumbar support.

This shopping and allocation plan distributes a **¥100,000 RMB budget** across furniture, home appliances, smart home systems, and soft decorative elements.

---

## 1. Budget Allocation Strategy & Spatial Concept

### Optimal Budget Breakdown (¥100,000 RMB Total)
To achieve a high standard of living without overspending on decorative items at the expense of core functional items, the budget is split across three primary categories:

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                     TOTAL BUDGET: ¥100,000 RMB                    |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------+
|  Category                         |  Percentage  | Amount (RMB)   |
+-----------------------------------+--------------+----------------+
|  1. Furniture (Living, Dining, 3B)|  45%         | ¥45,000 RMB    |
|  2. Appliances & Kitchen Hardware |  30%         | ¥30,000 RMB    |
|  3. Textiles, Lighting & Decor    |  25%         | ¥25,000 RMB    |
+-----------------------------------+--------------+----------------+
```

1. **Furniture (45% / ¥45,000 RMB)**: Focuses on daily interaction items—sofas, beds, ergonomic mattresses, dining sets, and storage units. Durability, pet resistance, and lumbar support are prioritized here [1, 2].
2. **Home Appliances & Smart Hardware (30% / ¥30,000 RMB)**: Focuses on essential large appliances (refrigerator, washer-dryer stack) and smart kitchen devices (built-in dishwasher, range hood set, micro-steamer oven) with precise fit for 89㎡ dimensions [3, 4].
3. **Soft Accessories, Textiles, Lighting & Décor (25% / ¥25,000 RMB)**: Injects visual warmth into the white-and-gray shell through warm lighting (3500K–4000K), double-layer drapery, low-pile cat-friendly rugs, art, and greenery [5, 6].

Microfiber tech cloth and cat-scratch fabrics feature ultra-dense weaving that prevents claws from penetrating the surface [1, 2]. They offer water repellency, stain resistance, and high abrasion resistance while retaining a soft touch [1].
* **Ergonomic Support**: Seats must support the natural S-curve of the spine to prevent lower back pain during reading or lounging, featuring high-density resilience foam and adjustable lumbar power mechanisms.
